messages:
ash: Hi team, kicking off the Q3 recurring-incident pattern retro. I pulled incidents from 2025-01-01..2025-06-30 and grouped by suspected root cause. Key repeats: autoscaler oscillation, HA DB failovers during rolling deploys, cache-thundering after cold starts, and infra config drift causing node label mismatches. Summary doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/q3-patterns-1751234000
maria: thanks ash. can you attach the list of incident IDs? want to cross-ref with postmortems.
ash: linked in the doc (INC-5501, INC-5540, INC-5612, INC-5633...). I'll paste the short mapping below.
devon: Quick note 14 the autoscaler ones look like the same symptom but two causes: (a) aggressive short-lived job spikes, (b) metric outliers from sidecars. We should separate them.
claire: Agree. For (b) sidecar metric noise, we recommended removing node-local sidecar emission on the last runbook but it didn't get scheduled. Owner: claire. ETA: 2025-04-20.
ops-bot: automated-summary: 2025-01-01..2025-06-30: total_incidents=64, repeat_root_cause=16, top_causes=[autoscaler:18%, db-ha:17%, cache-thundering:13%, config-drift:9%]
maria: Proposed prioritization: 1) DB HA during deploys (customer impact high), 2) autoscaler oscillation (cost & SLO), 3) cache warming, 4) config drift detection. Thoughts?
devon: +1. For DB HA: root cause was opaque client reconnect bursts after failover. Mitigation: connection pool backoff + client retry jitter. I'll own the change. ETA: 2025-04-02.
ash: For autoscaler: propose two tracks: short term: add smoothing (10s -> 60s cooldown) + require two consecutive metrics over threshold. long term: introduce queue-length autoscaling and bounded async-burst limit. Owner: ash. ETA short-term: 2025-03-12.
claire: cache-thundering: pattern shows most incidents coincide with canary-deploys that invalidate popular prefixes. Quick win: deploy hook to pre-warm top-100 prefixes + progressive cache invalidation. Owner: claire. ETA: 2025-03-25.
maria: Can someone create explicit JIRA tasks with acceptance criteria? We want measurable reduction: target is 50% fewer repeats by next quarter.
ash: I'll open tickets and include perf/regression tests. Ticket refs will be added to the doc.
devon: Also recommend adding a Console metric: "repeat_incident_rate" by root_cause with 90-day window and alert if >10% for any category. Ops SRE to implement.
ops-bot: scheduled: monthly follow-up reminders on the 5th at 10:00. First ping: 2025-03-05.
maria: Assignments recap:
  - DB client backoff + jitter 1 owner: devon 1 ETA: 2025-04-02
  - Autoscaler smoothing + metric gating 1 owner: ash 1 ETA: 2025-03-12
  - Cache pre-warm + progressive invalidation 1 owner: claire 1 ETA: 2025-03-25
  - Config drift detection (k8s labels + lint) 1 owner: maria 1 ETA: 2025-04-10
  - Console metric and dashboard tile for repeat incidents 1 owner: infra-bot/ops-sre 1 ETA: 2025-03-05
claire: small ask 1 can we add a column in postmortem template for "repeat? (Y/N)" and link to pattern-family tag. I'll update the template.
nash: good idea. that will make triage faster.
maria: One more: let's run a 30-day audit of incidents flagged as "repeat" and verify whether owners closed the upstream fix or just added short-term mitigations. owner: maria. ETA: 2025-04-15.
devon: For tracking, recommend a label on tickets: recurring-pattern=q3-2025. will add to all new tasks.
nash: I'll add a small load test harness to reproduce autoscaler oscillation. Will post results in this thread when ready.
ops-bot: action-created: JIRA-2311, JIRA-2312, JIRA-2313, JIRA-2314, JIRA-2315
maria: Thanks everyone. Let's sync in two weeks for a brief status check; I'll drop a calendar invite. If anyone needs to reassign, post here.
claire: ack.
devon: ack.
nash: :thumbsup:
